Question Choices: Fill: In triangle PQR, angle P = $52^\circ$ and angle Q = $(2x - 10)^\circ$. Angle R = $(x + 12)^\circ$. Find angle R in degrees.
Hints: The sum of the angles is 180 degrees
Solution: Triangle angles total 180°: (52)+((2 × x - 10))+((x + 12))=180. Combine like terms and solve to get x=42. The three angle measures are 52, 74, 54 degrees, all positive and totaling 180. Requested angleR=(x + 12)=54°.

Question Choices: Fill: An exterior angle of a triangle is $150^\circ$. One remote interior angle is $65^\circ$. Find the other remote interior angle.
Hints: The exterior angle equals the sum of the two remote interior angles
Solution: The exterior angle equals the sum of remote interior angles: 65+x=150. Therefore x=85°. The adjacent interior angle is 30°; all three interior angles total 180°.
